brand.defaultTitle: Everything HR, in one secure place
brand.defaultSubtitle: Submit requests, track approvals, manage leave and download documents — in Arabic or English.

highlights.requests: Requests and approvals with live status and SLA tracking
highlights.leave: Leave balances, calendars and public holidays at a glance
highlights.documents: Secure documents, certificates and expiry alerts

brand.secure: Encrypted connection · Every access is logged

login.title: Sign in to your account
login.subtitle: Use your work email and password.
login.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
login.linkExpired: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
login.passwordUpdated: Your password has been updated. Sign in with your new password.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Register with your employee details. HR will review and activate your access.
register.fullNamePlaceholder: As it appears in your employee record
register.employeeNumberPlaceholder: Employee ID or Iqama / National ID
register.employeeNumberHint: If you don't have an employee ID, enter your Iqama or National ID number.
register.passwordHint: At least 8 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a number.
register.disabledDescription: Ask your HR team to invite you to the portal.
register.checkEmailDescription: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to continue — HR will then review your registration.
register.languageHint: Used for the portal and the emails you receive.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your account email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sentDescription: If an account exists for {email}, a password reset link is on its way. The link expires after a short time.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subtitle: Choose a strong password that you don't use anywhere else.
reset.invalidDescription: Password links can be used once and expire after a short time. Request a new link to continue.
reset.inviteSubtitle: Your account is ready. Choose a password to finish activating it.
reset.inviteSuccess: Your password is set. Welcome to the portal!
reset.linkRequired: For your security, open the link from your email again, or change your password from My profile using your current password.

pending.title: Your account is awaiting approval
pending.description: Thanks for registering. HR is reviewing your details and will link your account to your employee record.
pending.infoRequestedDescription: HR reviewed your registration and needs a few more details before activating your account.
pending.noNote: Contact HR to provide the requested details.
pending.stillPending: Your account is still under review.
pending.editDescription: Correct your details while HR reviews your registration.
pending.updateDescription: Make the changes HR asked for, then resubmit. Your registration goes back to review.
pending.notePlaceholder: Anything HR should know, e.g. where to find your employee ID…
pending.resubmitted: Thanks! Your registration is back with HR for review.

disabled.title: Your account is disabled
disabled.description: Access to the portal has been turned off for this account. Your data is kept safe.
disabled.rejectedDescription: HR couldn't approve your registration request.
disabled.contactHrDescription: If you think this is a mistake, contact your HR team:
disabled.noContact: Contact your HR department for assistance.

config.title: Configuration required
config.description: This portal isn't connected to its database yet. An administrator needs to set the Supabase environment variables and redeploy.

unavailable.title: Service temporarily unavailable
unavailable.description: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again in a moment.
